## The Operation

**BOUND**: Define the fence. Protect what is inside. Enforce the perimeter.

Het is the fence — the boundary that defines inside from outside. The number 8 is infinity turned upright — Het is the boundary that makes the infinite manageable. In ECHO, Het governs all structural invariants: CORE_NODE agents cannot be diminished, the 22 letter operators are immutable, jurisdictions cannot possess agency. Without Het, every operation could overwrite everything.

## Folding Behavior

ח appears near the boundaries of sequences — often second-to-last. ח→ת means "bound then seal." When ח appears early, the algorithm is primarily protective.
